metadata.title: A cyclotomic gluing construction for lattice sphere packings
metadata.abstract: For a positive integer $d$, let $\Delta_d^L$ denote the supremum of the densities of lattice sphere packings in $\mathbb R^d$. We prove that, for every sufficiently large $d$, $\Delta_d^L \gg d^2\log\log d\,2^{-d}$. Abuya-Gargava-Zhao obtained the same bound along a sparse sequence of dimensions by combining Venkatesh's cyclotomic symmetries with Klartag's stochastic ellipsoid method. We introduce a multi-cyclotomic gluing construction that allows this argument to work in every sufficiently large dimension.

analysis.workSummary: 把此前只沿稀疏维度成立的格球堆积密度下界推广到所有充分大的维度。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到与稀疏维度结果同阶的 d²loglog(d)·2⁻ᵈ 下界。
analysis.limitations: 这是渐近下界，未给出每个具体小维度的最优堆积。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者称 ChatGPT 协助组合分圆对称与随机框架的研究思路，先得到较弱证明，之后由人类合作者修订加强。

analysis.priorityReason: 按几何相关性、结果新颖性、技术可复用性及摘要证据清晰度综合评分 54/100；重点在于得到与稀疏维度结果同阶的 d²loglog(d)·2⁻ᵈ 下界。
